reuse.why: Takes its categories from the existing getMonthActionCategories, reads spending via getSheetValue on the sum-amount cell, and registers through mutator(undoable(...)) like the other budget methods.

duplication.why: Extracts the income/tracking rule into shouldBudgetCategory and uses it in setZero and the averages; the per-category loop and the expense sign flip still mirror setAllCategoriesAverage, and copyPreviousMonth keeps its inline copy of the rule.

placement.why: Action in server/budget/actions.ts beside the other month-wide actions, handler registered in server/budget/app.ts.

scope.why: Focused on the new action; replacing the inline income check in setZero/averages with the new helper is a small related refactor that is applied incompletely (copyPreviousMonth untouched).

maintainability.why: Short, uses the shared selection, and a change to which categories are filled lands in one place; the sign rule remains repeated.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses getMonthActionCategories and the undoable mutator wrapper like the existing actions.

disguised_duplication.where: The is_income sign flip in setLastMonthSpending repeats the averages' inline logic openly; nothing is disguised.
